scope: Definitions and human-reviewed evidence only; no production implementation approval

hydration.positive: Explicit hydration/rehydration communication, clearly presented hydration product/range descriptors, and REPLENISHER when clearly presented as a beverage replenishment positioning descriptor.
hydration.descriptor_context: Accept the reviewed Ultima Replenisher presentations under the descriptor policy. Do not treat every occurrence of replenish/replenisher in any context as hydration.
hydration.non_evidence: Water, coconut-water or sports-drink category, powder/tablet/sachet format, individual minerals, electrolytes alone and water/fruit graphics alone do not establish hydration positioning.
examples_en: REPLENISHER in a clearly presented beverage replenishment positioning descriptor

electrolyte.positive: Explicit consumer-facing electrolyte(s) wording or its language equivalent attributed to the reviewed product.
electrolyte.non_evidence: Magnesium, potassium, sodium or other individual minerals, nutrition values, ingredient-only mentions, sports category and powder format alone are insufficient.
electrolyte.taste: Explicit electrolytes advertised for taste qualify as an electrolyte feature; preserve stated purpose separately and infer no hydration.

attribution_and_scope.front: Front-of-pack positioning labels refer to the target product and approved reviewed front evidence.
attribution_and_scope.back: Preserve back-panel ingredient and promotional mentions separately; a back-panel feature is not a front-pack positive.
attribution_and_scope.background: Words on unrelated products in a photograph are excluded as evidence for the target product, even when present in saved OCR.
attribution_and_scope.purpose: Store exact wording, stated/derived purpose, evidence scope and rationale separately from the two labels.
attribution_and_scope.negative: not_detected means no qualifying proposition in the approved reviewed scope, not a universal statement about every pack version.
attribution_and_scope.uncertainty: Retain detected / not_detected / ambiguous / unassessable. Approved ambiguity is valid reviewed evidence. No assessment must never be coerced to a negative.

taxonomy_compatibility: Fortification is already tracked. Preserve fortification and all 34 legacy flags, successful no-claim results and priority taxonomy unchanged. Create no mineral-fortification category. Emerging propositions are independent additive evidence.
image_review_attribution: Julia and ChatGPT, as explicitly confirmed by Julia. Codex independently inspected no images.
